title: WaterSound West "Blue Moon" 10 Blue Moon Lane
h1: WaterSound West "Blue Moon" 10 Blue Moon Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 2 Kayaks included with the home- Gas grill.- 5 Bikes- Flat screen TV's in all bedrooms.- 1,000 sq. ft. in wrap around porches- Located across the street from the pool and the park- As of 2/1, complimentary backpack sets (2 chairs, 1 umbrella) will be available for the 2026 year.- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience the quiet community and beautiful surroundings of WaterSound West! 10 Blue Moon Lane is a wonderful location across from the community pool and park!Gorgeous hardwood floors and a soft blue wall color give a calm and peaceful vibe to the open-concept first level. The living room offers an oversized sectional sofa and a giant flat-screen mounted tv. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with everything you need to prepare a delectable meal in style. This space boasts granite countertops, beautiful blue cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range. Guests can enjoy seating at the breakfast bar while watching the cooks at work, and additional seating is available at the nearby dining table.French doors lead to the spacious screened porch, which is the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee, lunch al fresco, or a favorite happy hour cocktail. Also on the first level is the stunning master suite, which showcases a luxurious king bed, a mounted flat-screen television, and private en suite bathroom with a glass-front shower and a dual-sink granite vanity.Guests can choose from a variety of sleeping arrangements on the second level. The first bedroom features a cozy king bed, a mounted flat-screen television, and a shared bathroom with a dual-sink granite vanity and a glass-front shower. The second bedroom offers two plush queen beds and access to the shared bathroom. Kids will love the bunk room, which features two sets of built-in, twin-over-twin bunk beds. This level also boasts a second master suite, complete with a luxurious king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo and a dual-sink granite vanity. The second-floor living room offers an additional space to hang out and features a mounted flat-screen tv, surround sound, and a cozy queen sleeper sofa. The final guest area is the third-floor loft bedroom, which offers a cozy full bed and a mounted flat-screen tv.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King BedSECOND FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed - Guest Bedroom: King Bed- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds- Bunk Room: 2 Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (4 Twin Beds) - Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) THIRD FLOOR:- Third Floor Tower - Full Bed** Bicycles are allowed in the WaterSound West Beach community on the streets. Due to safety and legal concerns, the WaterSound West HOA will no longer allow bicycles on the West Beach boardwalks. However, they are still permitted on the beach walkover, with the following provisions. (1) Bicycles must be walked from where the pavement ends at the clubhouse to the entrance of the beach walkover, where the railing begins; and (2) Bicycles must be ridden at the lowest possible speed while on the beach walkover. ***Unfortunately, the HOA does not allow guests to rent Low-Speed Vehicles.*Please note- availability of owner-provided amenities is not guaranteed.

Gorgeous hardwood floors and a soft blue wall color give a calm and peaceful vibe to the open-concept first level. The living room offers an oversized sectional sofa and a giant flat-screen mounted tv. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with everything you need to prepare a delectable meal in style. This space boasts granite countertops, beautiful blue cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range. Guests can enjoy seating at the breakfast bar while watching the cooks at work, and additional seating is available at the nearby dining table. French doors lead to the spacious screened porch, which is the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee, lunch al fresco, or a favorite happy hour cocktail. Also on the first level is the stunning master suite, which showcases a luxurious king bed, a mounted flat-screen television, and private en suite bathroom with a glass-front shower and a dual-sink granite vanity. Guests can choose from a variety of sleeping arrangements on the second level. The first bedroom features a cozy king bed, a mounted flat-screen television, and a shared bathroom with a dual-sink granite vanity and a glass-front shower. The second bedroom offers two plush queen beds and access to the shared bathroom. Kids will love the bunk room, which features two sets of built-in, twin-over-twin bunk beds. This level also boasts a second master suite, complete with a luxurious king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo and a dual-sink granite vanity. The second-floor living room offers an additional space to hang out and features a mounted flat-screen tv, surround sound, and a cozy queen sleeper sofa. The final guest area is the third-floor loft bedroom, which offers a cozy full bed and a mounted flat-screen tv. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: - Master Bedroom: King Bed SECOND FLOOR: - Master Bedroom: King Bed - Guest Bedroom: King Bed - Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds - Bunk Room: 2 Sets of Twin Bunk Beds (4 Twin Beds) - Additional Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) THIRD FLOOR: - Third Floor Tower - Full Bed ** Bicycles are allowed in the WaterSound West Beach community on the streets. Due to safety and legal concerns, the WaterSound West HOA will no longer allow bicycles on the West Beach boardwalks. However, they are still permitted on the beach walkover, with the following provisions. (1) Bicycles must be walked from where the pavement ends at the clubhouse to the entrance of the beach walkover, where the railing begins; and (2) Bicycles must be ridden at the lowest possible speed while on the beach walkover. ** *Unfortunately, the HOA does not allow guests to rent Low-Speed Vehicles. *Please note- availability of owner-provided amenities is not guaranteed.
